contract: Play MP4 tx3g and Matroska UTF-8, ASS/SSA or WebVTT to EOF through Player and TextBridge. Compare with live av_read_frame and the text decoders of the pinned FFmpeg formats build.

Fold emitted cue bytes and presentation and duration clocks with an explicit unknown marker in microseconds, plus WebVTT identifiers and settings. The ASS packet is opaque. For WebVTT, compare the demuxer's typed side data or the type-1 BlockAdditional exposed by its Matroska API; for the plain-text comparison project the decoded ASS Text field by resolving line and space escapes and removing override blocks. A source cue can preserve literal markup, zero or unknown durations and signed timestamps that the reference decoder or demuxer changes.
Preload the container on both sides. Opening and reading the container, decoding, folding and teardown are inside the operation.
